reviews.text:
I truly cannot say enough amazing things about VERGI and the incredible people who work here! My cat, Sufi, has been through so much, and I genuinely believe he wouldn’t be here today without the compassion, dedication, and lifesaving care he received from this team.

Sufi’s story started when he was found on the side of the road as a stray with a severely injured paw. Unfortunately, his leg couldn’t be saved, and he needed an amputation. Dr. Landers was absolutely incredible throughout the entire process and gave Sufi a second chance at life. Thanks to him and the amazing veterinary team, Sufi recovered beautifully and adjusted to life as a happy little tripod!

Just a few months later, we found ourselves back at VERGI for another terrifying emergency when Sufi developed a urinary blockage. Anyone who has experienced this with their cat knows how scary and life-threatening it can be. Dr. Trevino and Dr. Seely were absolutely phenomenal. Their knowledge, compassion, and dedication to Sufi’s care meant more to me than I can put into words. They worked so hard to get him through another difficult situation, and I will forever be grateful to them for saving his life.

I also want to give a HUGE shoutout to the veterinary technicians and front desk staff! They truly are the heart of this hospital. The technicians are incredibly hardworking, knowledgeable, patient, and compassionate. They do so much behind the scenes, often during incredibly stressful and emotional situations, and they deserve so much recognition for the work they do. The front desk staff are just as wonderful. They are often the first people you interact with during some of the scariest moments of being a pet owner, and their kindness, understanding, and willingness to help make such a difference.

What makes VERGI so special is that you can genuinely see how much these people LOVE animals. This isn’t just a job to them. They advocate for their patients, fight for them, comfort them, and do everything they can to give them a fighting chance. They see animals and families during some of their most vulnerable moments, and the amount of heart they put into their work is something I will never take for granted.

Sufi has now been given a second chance at life not once, but TWICE, because of the incredible people at VERGI. Today, he’s a happy, loved, three-legged little guy who gets to enjoy a life he might never have had otherwise.

There are truly not enough words to express how thankful I am to Dr. Landers, Dr. Trevino, Dr. Seely, the technicians, the front desk team, and everyone else who played a part in his care. These people save lives every single day, and I hope they know just how much of a difference they make to the animals and families they help.

From the bottom of my heart, THANK YOU, VERGI, for giving my sweet Sufi the chance to live the life he deserves. 🤍🤍🤍

For eight months I have been feeding a stray cat in my area in need of serious help, trying to get him to trust me so that I could take him in to Vergi,  but to no avail.  On 7 October, Henry was finally ready, and walked into my home.

I was able to corral him into a cage and took him to Vergi.

Vergi came highly recommended and now I know why! While on my way, I called and asked about what to do because this was not one of my cats but I love him as my own. From the very first phone call, Christi was super sweet and helpful. Kristie, another very kind technician consoled me because I was crying and even offered to buy me a snack form the vending machine because I hadn't eaten.

As time passed, the service remained awesome. Dani was very helpful and guided me through various processes while Jennifer supplied me not only with confidence that Vergi was the best choice, but comfort and kindness and hugs. :)  We discussed our love for animals as she carried me through various updates.  Linda was amazing and helped me redirect my thoughts when I was really sad about the news that Henry was very sick, beyond typical help. He needed his rest. Linda and Jennifer were very reassuring and loving.

I highly recommend this clinic. It's clean, kind and has nice amenities while you wait for your fur baby. Thank you guys for helping Henry have dignity at the end of his little difficult life. Better is the end of a matter than it's beginning, wise King Solomon said. (Ecclesiastes 7:8)

I would also like to add that Dr Watkins was super awesome, unbelievably understanding and historically pleasant. You can tell if she's absolutely dialed in what the human needs. For bedside manner, while being hellaciously busy was top notch. Kudos for whomever does decided to hire her!

THANK YOU VERGI for allowing that to be true in Henry's case.
Proverbs 12:10
Chicagokim

I cannot express enough gratitude for the extraordinary care, professionalism, and absolute empathy shown by the VERGI team. Bringing in a pet during a medical crisis is one of the most stressful experiences a pet owner can face, but the staff here transforms a terrifying situation into one where you feel completely supported, informed and validated.

What truly sets VERGI apart is the staff's combination of top-tier medical expertise and genuine humanity. They are completely transparent about costs, keeping you updated every step of the way, and their focus remains entirely on delivering exemplary patient care.

It's no surprise that VERGI has such an incredibly positive reputation, and that so many local dog-friendly groups and organizations (including police forces with K9 officers) trust VERGI with their animals' care.

Hi Richard,
Thank you so much for your review. We greatly appreciate it! We are always open, ready to help you again should you ever need our services!
Laura Noaker DVM, DACVIM

Don't bring your pet to this place. These people will try to squeeze money out of you by taking advantage of your situation. After charging me 750, they tried to pressure me into paying 3,200. I refused to pay that amount, and the next day when I took my dog ​​to her usual vet, he told me that she was fine, it was just a passing thing.

I took my dog for a bone stuck on her throat and they said it was $400 for the x rays and they dis that.. and later came back saying they need to take more x rays of her throat. For another $300 which i though it was the whole point of the first x rays. But i pay over $700 and after my dog look ok and they didnt do anything.. but kept insisting about pulling bones out of her throat for over $3000.. and didnt wanted to give my dog back kept insisting on the precedure for the dog and the dog was ok at that point

My GS.  Steelo Came to visit here today ! He had over Exerted his penis mounting his mate Meaning the skin went way too far back where it can’t go back into the sleeve. Poor guy was in pain when I brought him here! They fixed him right up ,!!!!. prices very affordable ,friendly and clean environment. These lady’s here really have empathy and patience and big, loving hearts for animals!! What a tough job they have! Just know if you bring you fury baby here !! They got you !! Shout out to Kristi , Sadia and Christa!!!

The compassion and care they showed to me and my boyfriend as we put down my beloved chihuahua of 17 years is unmatched.   All of the doctors are wonderful but Dr Trujillo was a blessing to have. He had seen her 2 weeks prior for a rapidly growing mass on her toe and last night he eased my concerns of “is this the right decision” and told me that it was not the wrong choice. Yes, I could have tried to go for more extreme treatment but due to her age I didn’t want to cause more harm than good and he was 100% supportive in my decision. I will gladly always bring my pets to Vergi.

I brought my pet on Thursday cause he couldn’t have bowl movement and he  was bleeding , The nurse  came unning after take my dog inside and tell us very desperately that we need to give them 12000 usd in front in order for them to check the dog cause he is an a real bad shape , well I was terrify and gave them my card , anyway to make this short they basically just passes fluids  to my dog , and tell me that my dog have to stay longer , I said no , I can’t afford it , so decided pick up the dog , so in order to get my dog back had to pay an extra 380 usd , lost almost 16000 usd and get my dog in a worst condition  that when he went in there, waiting for a second opinion , to see if this people just care about money and killing your pet 😡😡😡 BBB SHOULD BE AWARE OFF THIS ,just waiting on my dog to get better to send them all the evidence ,
Wish could give them 0000 stars
Please don’t bring your dog to this inhumanity place

12 days later my dog is perfectly fine , thanks God , he recovered at home , thanks God didnt allow this people to kill him

Brought my French Bulldog in for an emergency ICU stay over the weekend, and the medical team was outstanding. They didn't play guessing games as they ran thorough diagnostics right away (ultrasound, STAT radiologist consult, full bloodwork) to rule out blockages and started aggressive, targeted care for pancreatitis immediately.

​The doctors and ICU technicians kept him comfortable and monitored around the clock. When you drop off a critical pet at a 24/7 ER on a busy weekend, you want clinical competence and straight answers, and that is exactly what we got. He’s back home and recovering well. Huge thanks to the staff for taking great care of Thor!

No more bully sticks!

My husband waited two hours with Theo despite being the only person in the waiting room. Theo had suddenly lost coordination a few hours after taking Bravecto, but after taking him back twice, staff told us he had a hurt leg and was old.

They proposed blood work, multiple MRIs, and CT scans, yet said they would charge us just to call Bravecto’s manufacturer because they might be on hold. We felt dismissed and pressured to spend money while Theo was clearly in distress. This was unacceptable.

I cannot say enough good things about this place. The front desk staff were very friendly and informative. Evelyn made sure we were comfortable the entire time we were waiting to be seen. My dog is reactive and typically has to be medicated for visits but that wasn’t possible in an emergent 4am situation. The staff handled her with such care to make the situation as stress free as possible. They truly care about you as a pet parent as well as your animal.

I honestly would not recommend this place. I understand sometimes it is full or there are higher priorities. BUT I came in there because my cat was slashed in his chest, it took them about 3 hours to attend us which is okay. (Thank you Lori) BUT once attended (5 hours later) they told us what he needed, which was just bandages. So, the invoice came in and charged us so much and for stuff the cat did not need. Then we had to wait 2 hours so they could give us a new one with unnecessary things. Which was still expensive but I wanted him safe. Mind you, the whole time the cat was not being bandaged at all. It was only after I paid for it. Then, we were told they would call us, and they never did. It was only until I went up there myself to get my cat at 6am. We were there since 8pm. The vet had told us to not change the bandage at all and to come back. Also, 1 day later his bandage started to stink. I called them to check what that meant since it was not specifically a fish smell. They told us it was nothing to worry about, so I kept cleaning around. I could not bear the smell and so I took him to a local vet. There the vets were in disbelief. They told us the cat needed surgery/stitches because his skin was now so dead that only his bone was visible.  He said whoever recommended bandages was wrong. So, they had to take skin from another place to fill in the hole he had. They were even more baffled when they saw what we paid for the bandages, sedation, and medication. The vets were so disgusted at what was left under the bandage and felt so bad that they gave us a discount. By the way, the vet was way cheaper. I don't know if the Vergi vets were tired but c'mon man. I understand that, just next time let people know. I would show pictures but I don't think they would be up for very long. I am so thankful for the local vets I found because now my cat is doing well. I forgot the name but if I find it I will attach it here.
Phenomenal hospital. My sweet peaches was rushed in and took great care of her. VERGI saved her life. I couldn't be more pleased with this beautiful facility.

We brought our sweet Betty girl here a few months ago while she was in labor after already having her first kitten. The staff here was so accommodating to us. We were offered a room to let Betty and her baby rest while waiting on the doctor. We were given pillows and blankets for Betty and for ourselves to rest until we were seen. The doctor found out that one of Betty’s kittens was too big for her to push so she needed an emergency c-section. The surgey was so quick. The staff made us feel so comfortable while we were so scared for our baby, and they answered every single question I had after bringing Betty home so quickly. I definitely recommend this Vet ER if you ever need an emergency vet. The staff here cares so deeply for you and your baby. Months later, Betty and sweet girl Ivy are happy and healthy! Thank you Vergi!

We are incredibly grateful to the entire VERGI team for taking such wonderful care of our cat, Cheetah. Everyone was kind, compassionate, and professional during a very stressful time for us.

A special thank you to Dr. Roberto Trevino for his exceptional care and for being so supportive and reassuring throughout Cheetah’s treatment. It meant so much to us.

Thank you, VERGI, for everything you did for Cheetah!

Tonight my sister & I had to say Good-bye to our Dear cat, Rusty😢🙏 He suddenly, & w/o cause, went into respiratory distress w/ a respiratory rate of 110 & a heart rate of 200 on arrival to the clinic.
He was rushed to triage, placed on 02, & given medicine to help him breath easier.
We were told he was Critical, Very Fragile, & unable to go home.

Dr. Copeland, DVM, was so compassionate & knowledgeable, & the staff was very supportive during this challenging time.

This episode came on so suddenly, & there was no guarantee that Rusty would pull through, even w/ the best veterinary practices in place.
We didn't want him to suffer.

It broke our hearts to let go of our baby. He was a feral rescue that wondered into my sister Linda's duplex in College Station one day, when the front door was open. It was like he chose her❣️
He was almost 6 yrs old.

So, with the strength & courage of a Great Cat Mommy, Rusty entered his eternal resting place tonight, peacefully & calmly, fully supported by his family & the caring staff @ Vergi 24/7.
We Thank Everyone of You there, from the bottom of our hearts, that participated in his care tonight💖🐾💙
We highly recommend this clinic to anyone that loves their fur baby🐾😘🐾
Our cat came and got his towel amputated the staff is great special shout out to Wendy Gonzales.

I can’t say enough good things about this clinic! I was extremely worried about my 7-month-old pug after he was poisoned, but Dr. Watkins and Veterinary Technician Lori reassured me and my family throughout the entire experience.

Dr. Watkins also listed many plans that were suitable for my family and I’s financial needs.

Ms. Lori especially went above and beyond by showing me how to properly give his medication and encouraging us through such a stressful time. I’m so grateful for their kindness, patience, and compassion. Truly the best experience I could have asked for, and I’m so happy to say my pug is doing much better as seen in the picture! ❤️

Hi J.R., 

Thanks for your 5 star review! We appreciate it.  

VERGI team
Vergi is an excellent choice for emergency pet problems.  They are fair in their pricing and caring to our pets.  They are absolutely the best choice for exceptional emergency services.

We cannot thank VERGI enough. We were transferred to Vergi by our primary vet when our Cavalier started vomiting blood and had extremely low blood platelet levels. Within a few days of hospitalization, our fur baby was diagnosed with Pneumonia and potential blood clotting, and had to be put on oxygen. During an extremely emotional and stressful time, the doctors were so caring, attentive, and patient with us - while also willing to spend time answering all of our questions. They gave us confidence through their knowledge and thoroughness, evaluating every detail, and making sure nothing was overlooked.

BIG thank you to Dr. Trujillo, Dr. Travino, Dr. Clower, and ALL the many technicians and staff members who cared for our baby for 7 days. We are now on the road to recovery and our hearts are immensely grateful 💙

The staff was extremely friendly and patient with us. Dr. Daily in particular was very patient with us, knowing the difficult decision we needed to make. We were given a private room and left undisturbed for hours to spend time with our beloved before saying goodbye. 7 hours. It was incredible, they never rushed us. I appreciate their kindness in our absolute worst possible time.
They are great! They saved my baby life after he was poisoned with helium

We took in our almost 16 year old miniature schnauzer yesterday early in the morning and we couldn't have had a better experience, we had a amazing Vet named Dr Trevino he was the most empathetic, sweet , kind , thoughtful soul and made our furry babies transition so calm, gentle and beautiful, we feel so blessed to have experienced this, thank you for this gift, anyone that needs to put their dog down please take him to this amazing doctor. He is living in his purpose. Thank you from our heart. Dr. Trevino you are amazing.

Unfortunately, I had to bring my pet in after finding my baby had passed away. Nathan was incredibly kind, patient, and so reassuring while explaining my options over the phone, which made a very difficult situation a little easier. Thank you to young gentleman upfront, the nurses, and the doctor for being so compassionate and caring during such a difficult time. I truly appreciate the kindness, support, and fair pricing. I’ll definitely continue bringing my pets here.

They took great care of my boy tonight for which I am grateful. Jennifer was absolutely amazing. She made us feel valued and not alone as we waited for test results. Thank you so much, Jennifer. You are an absolute angel on earth.

I am writing this 5 days after my dog passed from DKA and other complications. I admitted my baby to Vergi on July 15th when a routine check up showed he had ketones and glucose in his urine. We did not know he was diabetic as he had been a healthy dog. He was there until Sunday morning when they said he was much better and ready to go. During that whole process, frustrating is the kindest word I can use. We visited him twice a day while he was there, and they said that he wasn't able to have any bowel movement because "sometimes they don't like the artificial grass." So I took him to the areas in front of the clinic where it has real grass and he did his business. You're telling me we are paying over $2,000.00 a day and no one could be bothered to try to take him out there? Also, when I was cleaning him, I noticed his fur around his rectal area was filthy dirty, he had been having diarrhea and it was all dried up. I got wet wipes to clean him down. I brought this up to the vet and she said she would remind the techs to make sure to clean better. On Friday and Saturday when we visited, we asked what his ketone level was, and they said that they ran out of the accurate strips so had to use one that shows a range. They told us it was a range from 1.5-4. That is an enormous gap, and I do not understand how an emergency clinic does not have the proper tests for a dog that is severely sick like this. I took him home on Sunday when he was discharged, and he did not seem like himself. On Monday, he would not eat so I could not administer his insulin, I called Vergi to ask the doctor what I should do. The receptionist said the doctor would call in 5 minutes. An hour passes, still no call so I call again. The receptionist apologizes and says the doctor is busy. I drive him to the clinic, it was not even busy, the doctor saw me within 10 minutes. She was too busy to return my call but was able to see me quickly once they thought they could extract more money from me, after over $6,000.00 was already spent. She wanted to admit him again, saying that they are at point A again, and subject him to more tests and poking him constantly. At this point, I had enough and drove him 2 hours to a different vet that was recommended to me. I wish I had taken him there first instead. This was the first vet that was the most honest with his assessment. He said that my dog had pancreatitis, along with liver issues with the DKA. He said he could take him in and start a plan for him, but he said that the likelihood of success was very low, and that it would be hard on him to go through vigorous treatment again after he had been in the hospital for 4 days already. We made the difficult decision to make him comfortable and bring him home, where he passed the next morning. If I had admitted him to Vergi again, he would've passed in their cold , uncaring clinic, and I truly thank the other Vet for being honest with us. The vet looked through the records that was sent from Vergi and said that he does not want to point fingers, but proper numbers were not disclosed when my dog was discharged. Looking at the other reviews, the owner is more focused on making excuses for the clinic instead of taking some accountability and trying to improve their clinic. I truly pray that no one has to go through this type of pain and ordeal, please research other clinics that have proper equipment. The other vet I went to was able to give me an exact reading of his ketone level and recognized he had pancreatitis right away, while Vergi was not able to discern that the whole time there. I understand clinics are not cheap and need to make money, but it felt like they were more focused on making sure to collect enough payment to take care of him, making it that much more stressful.

For as long as my family and I have had pets, we have relied on VERGI for emergency care. Unfortunately, this morning we had to make the tough decision for euthanasia for one of our babies. I was crying too much to express our genuine gratitude to Dr. Trevino on the handling of our visit. He had such a calming presence and shared some personal words of encouragement over our precious girl. Dr. Trevino, thank you for how you do, what you do. You made a painful moment a little less so. We appreciate you and the rest of the staff.

disgusted by what I've discovered in the discharge paperwork for my cat who I brought in after a seizure.

firstly there is an error in the "plan" portion of the paperwork. it indicates that my cat had a seizure "with urination during that episode." I specifically told them he did NOT urinate during the episode.

Here is the part I'm so upset and disgusted about. "No known ingestion of foreign material or medications is reported. Another household cat previously died at age 3 from seizures."

My 3 year old died from seizures related to a HEART CONDITION. The implication of this detail being included in the paperwork right after the foreign material/medication line is insulting, insensitive, and flagrantly accusatory. How DARE you suggest I am at fault for my other cats death. I acknowledge the plausible deniability of this implication on its own. But theres another one.

"Owner declined initial plan due to finances and overall concern."

The initial plan was the standard dealings of any emergency vet, a litany of tests and xrays that are unnecessary and redundant to perform all at once. I get it, you have to keep the lights on. To suggest that my refusal to be financially exploited is indicative of my lack of "overall concern" is again, disgusting and insulting. I was in tears at multiple points in the evaluation. My concern is VERY present and INSURMOUNTABLE. Again, How dare you.

To add insult to injury, they kept my cat there for almost 7 hours. All they performed was the catalyst chem 17 CBC. That shouldn't take even 1 hour, let alone 6. He should have been released immediately after it was completed.

The vet seemed like a nice guy, reasonable with my financial concerns (which by the way are because I have a disabled child, which i expressed). I was surprised and horrified by what the paperwork revealed.

I'm very disappointed that seemingly no visit to an emergency vet is without shenanigans. Unfortunately, VERGI is no different from the rest.
We went this past Saturday. Everyone was super friendly and professional.
Nathan was the friendliest and most compassionate along with Jamie

Thank you Vergi! River was cared after so well and we can’t thank you enough.  Jennifer was so helpful and especially loving for our 1yo lab. Thank you Jennifer. Dr. Abby, Dr. Clower and Dr. Rita and many others too. We appreciate you saving our sweet boy River
Jennifer and Mason provided me with excellent service. The staff was very friendly and attended to my pet as soon as I arrived. I highly recommend this service; all the staff provide great service.

100% recommended! Excellent care from the moment we arrived at the emergency room in the early hours of the morning with my dog ​​Coco. The doctors and nurses did a fantastic job, and we are beyond happy that they saved my dog's life. Thank you!
Amazing team and facility.
Michelle was amazing and provided the best care for our sweet Lucky and family!!!!
Nathan is very kind and gave us many options.
Thank you Vergi for taking such good care of our Conway, especially Michelle.  This is the place to go for a pet emergency.  You all love our baby as much as we do.  Thank you.
Michelle and Karen took great care my baby cat!!!

Vergi helped save Thumbelinas life! Another vet told us that our options were to either take her to emergency care or put her down so we took her to Vergi (where I’ve taken all of my other pets for emergencies in the past) and they saved her life. She was truly hanging in by a thread. I’m so grateful to Dr. Watkins, Dr. Weigle, Dr.Trevino, Dr Clower and all the techs who helped save her.
It's a very welcoming place, and the staff service was what we liked most. Jennifer helped us and was truly wonderful. We appreciate her service.
Brought in my 3 year old cat with a VERY swollen leg, team took great care of my little guy. He loved it

My foster Max had an intestinal blockage that our vet couldn’t verify due to intestinal swelling. We were referred to Vergi and once we arrived Max was almost immediately taken to the back. He stayed overnight and the surgeon removed an old corncob that had been causing his blockage (the corncob was ancient and was likely from his previous owner/situation).

Vergi took the best care of my boy and I’m super grateful! Their new location next to Collins’s is so much nicer than their previous location. It’s clean, quiet, and secure. The staff is friendly and will let you visit during visiting hours 10am-10pm.

Jennifer and the rest of the staff we interacted with during our time there made a stressful situation much better with friendly faces, calm demeanors and always kind & professional discussions.  Our pup is doing well and I"m thankful to have professionals like this available when emergencies arrise.
Jennifer

On behalf of BH Outreach Ranch of Texas Rescue, we are incredibly grateful for Dr. Noaker and the entire team at VERGI 24/7 Emergency Hospital.

From the moment Phoenix arrived, every veterinarian, technician, and staff member treated him with exceptional kindness, compassion, professionalism, and genuine love. Their thoroughness and attention to detail have given us confidence that Phoenix is receiving the very best care possible.

When Phoenix arrived at VERGI, he was in heartbreaking condition, severely emaciated after spending the majority of the past year confined to a kennel with inadequate nutrition and care. Despite everything he had endured, he showed no hesitation in trusting the doctors, technicians, and staff. He greeted everyone with a wagging tail, accepted gentle handling without fear, and soaked up every bit of love and attention he received. Watching a dog who had experienced such neglect place his trust so freely in the VERGI team was a powerful testament to both Phoenix’s resilient spirit and the compassionate, calming care provided by the hospital staff.

Although Dr. Noaker was not Phoenix’s primary treating veterinarian, as the owner of VERGI she has personally taken the time to speak with me about his care, show sincere compassion for his situation, and go above and beyond to ensure he has received the medical attention and support he needs. Her leadership and commitment to excellence are evident throughout the entire hospital.

As a rescue organization, we’ve also had the opportunity to witness VERGI care for many other rescue animals. Time and again, we’ve seen frightened, neglected, abused, and critically ill animals treated with patience, dignity, and compassion. It is clear that every life matters to this team.

VERGI doesn’t just provide emergency veterinary care…they provide hope. They have helped save countless rescue animals, and their dedication to both the animals and the people advocating for them is truly remarkable.

Thank you to Dr. Noaker and every member of the VERGI family for your unwavering commitment to saving lives. Phoenix is just one of many animals whose future is brighter because of your exceptional care.

We wholeheartedly recommend VERGI 24/7 Emergency Hospital to anyone seeking compassionate, skilled, and life-saving veterinary care.

EVIL PEOPLE!
DO NOT GO HERE!

I am disgusted with the level of customer service received from here both Dany and Cris their supposed manager who was outrageously disrespectful to me and denied services to me after they fell to call me back about a blood transfusion and then hung up on me while we were on the phone. I have not screamed at them or cursed at them or nothing, and I am being shut down in a way after trying to help my senior citizen mother with her cat who needs a blood transfusion, and I am literally in tears at how I have been treated when I am trying to help a cat that is suffering. This is disgusting horrible evil behavior by your staff. I will never trust this company with any animal ever.

There is no kindness. There is no compassion. There is zero level of care for anyone or their pet when there is an urgent need for help. And this is disheartening because I’m in the rescue community and I have done so much for so many animals and have brought business to this company and to be treated this way is sickening. The owner should be ashamed to have the staff that they have representing this company.
Great staff. Made us feel comfortable and at ease with our decision 😌 …

We are so grateful for the quick response and wonderful care we received at Vergi. From the front desk to vet care, we had a very positive experience. I hope we don’t have another emergency anytime soon but if we do, we know where to go.
Dasia & the rest of the staff were super nice and helpful. Did take over an hour to see the vet.
Great service thank you for helping my little dog brother Milo!! Thank you Jennifer, dr.Lauren and the whole team great service !
Excellent experience, they treat you like family, especially Jennifer, who is very, very kind!

Thank you to Jennifer and Dr. Lauren for the wonderful care they gave my dog, Milo. We arrived very worried, but Jennifer was incredibly kind and explained everything clearly. Dr. Lauren was caring, professional, and attentive. Thanks to them, we left feeling reassured and much happier. I highly recommend this team and their clinic! 🐾❤️

I’ve been here multiple times but went in today for my Marla’s GI issues. Dr gave me multiple options for treatment and was patient with all of my questions. The team was very sweet to my Marla Meatballs and took great care of her!

We brought Krusty in a couple weeks ago on a Saturday when our regular vet was closed and he was having tummy issues and very clearly felt awful. The team at Vergi clearly love the animals they care for. Madeline was especially helpful. She answered all my questions, told me what to expect and gave me clear instructions for home care and administering meds. Being a 24/7 emergency vet the prices were high, but they were very transparent about it. Krusty started feeling better in a couple days and completely back to his happy and playful self in less than a week. Definitely recommend Vergi for emergency care. 🐾

We had a pet pass away and Nathan was very thorough and helpful. The process was painless and the prices were very affordable. For all the years I have had pets, this is my best experience with pet care ever. Thank you and keep up the great work you are doing for the animal community & animal lovers! 🫶🏾 …
Very kind, she helped me with my Tobby who was sick, and the service was excellent. I highly recommend Yenifer.

I have used Vergi for years and have always received excellent service.  I have referred many friends.  Today my Lil Gem was having a lot of pain and I took him to Vergi where he received excellent care.  The doctor and other staff were extremely helpful in taking care of Lil Gem and putting me at ease. Nathan was very helpful throughout our visit.
Very good service, thank you thank you so much, Jennifer for your help
best knows
Amazing Vet ER. Took care of us in a quick and caring manner. Followed up after. Can’t recommend enough!
Very compassionate and very understanding helping me navigate my pet's last day. Very appreciative and thankful to the staff.
Excellent care from the doctors and Jennifer

I want to thank the Vergi Hospital and all the staff, from the receptionists to the doctors, for their wonderful care of our furry little angel, Poppy, and us. We went to several clinics, and no one wanted to help us because of her terminal condition. When we arrived, they told us she might die, but thanks to God and the great work of the highly trained doctors, they were able to give her a second chance. Now Poppy is much better at home, recovering, eating, and sleeping happily.

Always friendly and as prompt as can be with an emergency vet. We feel that we can bring our furry family here and they get the best care.
